summary.text: Skyler Rude is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives for District 16-Position 2, in office since January 14, 2019, and he is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Derek Sarley.
He is a ranking member of the House Education, Postsecondary Education and Workforce, and Appropriations committees.

paragraphs.text: Rude previously served as legislative assistant to Republican state Senator Maureen Walsh and worked as a Realtor in Walla Walla, according to his House Republican biography.
He currently runs a stagecoach tour business in the Walla Walla Valley.
Rude was elected in 2018 to succeed retiring Republican Terry Nealey.
His biography says he is one of the House Republican Caucus's assistant floor leaders and co-founded a bipartisan work group in his first year to help legislators build relationships.
He also serves on the Joint Higher Education Committee and other bipartisan boards, the biography says.
